title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
abstract: arXiv:2610.29196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. translated_title: 边缘VLM时代物理对抗鲁棒性的统一评估框架
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型的最新进展使其能够通过语言提示和生成式解码实现端到端的视觉定位，展现出显著提升的零样本和开放词汇检测能力。因此，VLM正迅速被部署于安全攸关的现实世界系统的边缘设备上。然而，边缘VLM的物理对抗鲁棒性尚未得到系统性研究，且其输出形式与现代目标检测器存在根本差异，为公平评估带来了方法论上的挑战。为了直接比较这两类模型，我们对每个选定的代表性模型在同一个结果上进行评估：佩戴在人体上的对抗补丁能否逃逸模型的检测。我们通过引入一个统一指标——条件攻击成功率来报告这一结果，该指标仅在模型在匹配的灰色遮挡物下仍能定位目标的图像上进行统计，并将所有失败划分为漏检、替换
tldr: 本文提出了边缘VLM时代物理对抗鲁棒性的统一评估框架，引入条件攻击成功率指标，在对抗补丁攻击下公平比较了视觉语言模型与传统目标检测器的鲁棒性差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified evaluation framework for physical adversarial robustness in the edge VLM era, introducing the conditional attack success rate (cASR) metric to fairly compare vision-language models with traditional object detectors under adversarial patch attacks.
